statement: In the retained admissible antipodal p:2p R-151 chart at fixed finite cutoff, condition on the strict past and decompose the field/current into fixed means m,n and a centered stationary common-even future with zero same-point field-current cross covariance. Direct differentiation of the complete covariance-normal endpoint gives one primitive trace outside the spatial-gradient sum and the exact current-mean correction with coefficients 2,1,1/2. On the enlarged fixed-mean field/current class, arbitrary m with n=0 preserves endpoint Hessian loss strictly below 19/25 and hence augmented curvature strictly above 7/50 for every nonzero linear H; production normally also imposes n_i=partial_i m, and no first-variation cancellation is claimed. With the declared almost-sure conditional collar C_past<=1/25, the curvature is strictly above 1/10. For every bounded predictable simple fixed-law nonlinear direction on the declared form core, the same 1/10 lower bound is equivalent to the complete conditional endpoint-plus-sixth-power operator K being at least -4I/5 almost surely; R-151 averaged linear tests do not imply this, as an exact one-Gaussian-coordinate translated-bump form fixture shows. At the finite cylindrical/root-coordinate matrix level, multi-root globalization requires the fully recombined M=E+(9/10)G+S+L to satisfy M>=mu G, with the generalized-eigenvalue or kernel-Schur test; orthogonal source incidence and positive pairwise local gaps do not imply it, as an exact two-edge matrix with local gaps 3/20 and global eigenvalues -1/20,7/20 shows. The fixtures are logical non-implication witnesses, not A1 or production counterexamples. R-152 closes the bounded post-R-151 review only; T-050, A13, Nelson, all phase/PDE verdicts, and Sector A remain open.
